resources.string: Lets the remote\'s volume keys control the optical (S/PDIF) output in apps, with the TV speakers kept silent.
On HDMI, AV and Live TV
The accessibility service is off: turn it on in Settings > Accessibility

Digital volume: in apps (Netflix, YouTube…) the remote\'s volume keys control the optical output and the TV speakers stay off. Off: the TV works as it came from the factory.\n\nHDMI, AV and Live TV audio does not pass through Android, so it cannot be controlled digitally. TV control: there the keys drive the TV speakers, with their own remembered volume. Fixed: the TV speakers stay off; use the connected device or your audio system for volume.
